WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.TITLE: Templates
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: View the message templates synced from your WhatsApp inboxes. To create or edit a template, manage it with your provider.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_SUCCESS: Template sync started for all WhatsApp inboxes. Updates may take a couple of minutes.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_SYNC_ERROR: Template sync started for some WhatsApp inboxes, but others could not be synced.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_ERROR: Unable to start template sync. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.FETCH_ERROR: Unable to load WhatsApp templates. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_FETCH_ERROR: Some WhatsApp templates could not be loaded. Please try again.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Template preview
PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Preview how this template appears in WhatsApp.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_BUILDER.TITLE: Create WhatsApp template
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_BUILDER.CATEGORY_LABEL: What type of template is this?

INBOX.LABEL: WhatsApp inbox
INBOX.EMPTY: No WhatsApp Cloud API inbox is available.

CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS.UTILITY: Share an update with a customer

NAME.LABEL: Template name
NAME.HELPER: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only.

CATALOG.REQUIREMENT: Catalog templates work only when a Meta Commerce Catalog is connected to the WhatsApp Business Account.
CATALOG.CATALOG_BUTTON_HELPER: Meta adds the fixed View catalog button. No button fields are required here.
CATALOG.PRODUCT_CAROUSEL_HELPER: Meta requires exactly two product cards when the template is created. Up to 10 products are selected later when the approved template is sent.

PRODUCT_TYPES.SINGLE_DESCRIPTION: Show one product from the connected catalog.
PRODUCT_TYPES.MULTI_DESCRIPTION: Show multiple products grouped into sections.

BUTTONS.SPM_HELPER: The View product button is fixed by Meta. Product details are loaded from the catalog when the message is sent.
BUTTONS.URL_HELPER: A URL button requires its label and destination URL.

FORMATS.CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Open the full connected catalog using Meta's fixed button.
FORMATS.CAROUSEL_DESCRIPTION: Create two product-card definitions for a swipeable product carousel.
FORMATS.PRODUCTS_DESCRIPTION: Choose between a single-product or multi-product message.

HEADER.EXAMPLE_PLACEHOLDER: Enter a realistic value for variable 1
HEADER.UPLOAD_HELPER: Select a supported example file for the template preview.
HEADER.MEDIA_ERROR: Select a supported file within the allowed size for this header type.

BUTTONS.FLOW_HELPER: The Flow behavior and entry screen are inherited from its published configuration in Meta.

MARKETING_API.DEEP_LINK_HELPER: Open content in your Android app, with the website URL used on other devices.
MARKETING_API.GIF_MODE_HELPER: Upload an MP4 file up to 3.5 MB. This format requires Marketing Messages API.

AUTHENTICATION.PRESET_HELPER: Meta generates the verification message from fixed, localized text. Media, links, emojis, and custom message text are not supported.

TYPES.COPY_CODE_DESCRIPTION: Let the user copy the verification code.
TYPES.ONE_TAP_DESCRIPTION: Open the Android app and fill the code.
TYPES.ZERO_TAP_DESCRIPTION: Deliver the code to the Android app automatically.

AUTHENTICATION.SECURITY_HELPER: Add Meta's localized warning not to share the code.
AUTHENTICATION.APPS_HELPER: One-tap and zero-tap require an Android package name and its 11-character signing key hash.
AUTHENTICATION.ZERO_TAP_TERMS: I accept the Zero-tap terms and confirm that customers expect the verification code to be filled automatically.

ARABIC.SECURITY: حرصًا على أمانك، لا تشارك هذا الرمز.
ARABIC.EXPIRATION: تنتهي صلاحية هذا الرمز خلال {minutes} دقيقة.

ENGLISH.SECURITY: For your security, do not share this code.

CAROUSEL.TITLE: Message cards
CAROUSEL.DESCRIPTION: Add between 2 and 10 cards with consistent media and actions.
CAROUSEL.BODY_HELPER: Required message text shown above the carousel cards.
CAROUSEL.IMAGE_HELPER: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Used as the template example.
CAROUSEL.VIDEO_HELPER: MP4 or 3GPP, up to 16 MB. Used as the template example.
CAROUSEL.CARD_BODY_PREVIEW: Your card message will appear here.
CAROUSEL.MEDIA_ERROR: Select a supported media file within the allowed size.

ACTIONS.TITLE: Buttons
ACTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Button types and order apply to every card. You can customize their values per card.
ACTIONS.TEXT_ERROR: Button text must not exceed 25 characters.
ACTIONS.URL_HELPER: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS URL.
ACTIONS.URL_ERROR: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
ACTIONS.URL_EXAMPLE_PLACEHOLDER: Enter the value that replaces variable 1
ACTIONS.PHONE_HELPER: Use international E.164 format, including the + and country code.
ACTIONS.PHONE_ERROR: Enter a valid international phone number, for example +1234567890.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_BUILDER.SUBMIT_SUCCESS: Template submitted to WhatsApp for review.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_BUILDER.MEDIA_STORAGE_WARNING: Meta accepted the template, but its media could not be saved locally. Do not submit it again; ask an administrator to check storage.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_BUILDER.SUBMIT_ERROR: Unable to submit the template to WhatsApp. Please check the fields and try again.

PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: This is how your template will appear in WhatsApp.
